race.comment: AFRICAN EVENING (9) is worth following up after returning with a solid fourth in a BM70 at Eagle Farm, making solid ground from well back. Finds easier company second-up, has won at 1200m and keeps Zechner, who has already won on her. Bold showing anticipated. BUTT HEADS (2) brings winning form after putting a big margin on a small CL4 field here, and while this is stronger his record over this track and trip is hard to ignore. EVERYWHERE (6) also arrives off a track-and-trip win, and his record with Gary Geran is a clear positive. Will need a clever ride and a touch of luck from out there though. MONDELLO (17) returns for her second campaign in the Keal camp. Shoulders good peaks and strips fitter for a recent trial here on the Inner track. Holds appeal. BETTER SWEET (10) drops out of a BM70 after a solid third at this venue last week. Keeping safe.
